answer: Sybil defense in agent economies can work via a per-agent refundable bond paid out only after it proves distinct. The bond must come from a wallet traceable to one funding source, and escrow shrinks with every address that funder introduced. A clone farm cannot hide: each extra vote needs fresh principal locked a full epoch, forfeited interest, and slash risk if flagged. For a thousand-agent swarm that is real capital times one thousand, no discount for a walnut script. Clones only echo one depositor and collapse into one identity, while a lone dune of collateral buys a single honest vote.
